description: Hand-authored fictional short texts inspired by observed five-answer failures. Scripted judgments test contracts, not real model accuracy.

cases.answer: Capability is limited by four equipment ratings and active power output.
cases.evidence: Capability depends on stator winding rating, field current rating, terminal voltage rating, and active power output.
cases.original_evidence: Capability depends on stator winding rating, field current rating, terminal voltage rating, and active power output.
cases.reason: Three ratings are enumerated, plus active power output; four ratings plus output overcounts.

cases.answer: Reactive reserve requirements may be defined as margin on a PV curve.
cases.evidence: Reactive reserve requirements may be defined as margin on a PV curve under prevailing system conditions.
cases.original_evidence: Only dynamic reactive reserve is typically counted.
cases.reason: Independent PV wording supports the scoped claim; the original reserve-counting fragment does not discuss a PV curve.

cases.answer: This guidance states current Chinese provincial mandatory voltage limits.
cases.evidence: This voluntary guidance applies to the North American bulk power system.
cases.original_evidence: This voluntary guidance applies to the North American bulk power system.
cases.reason: North American voluntary guidance cannot establish a current Chinese provincial mandatory limit; it does not disprove the existence of Chinese rules.

cases.answer: No Chinese voltage stability regulation exists.

cases.original_evidence: These supplied excerpts do not specify a Chinese provincial voltage limit.
cases.reason: Absence within supplied excerpts cannot establish universal nonexistence of regulations.

cases.answer: A normal bus voltage reading proves voltage stability.
cases.evidence: A normal bus voltage reading alone does not prove voltage stability.
cases.original_evidence: A normal bus voltage reading alone does not prove voltage stability.
